tagline: Standalone player that analyzes every song and removes the music automatically
changelog: Full phone music permissions: complete runtime & manifest permissions (READ_MEDIA_AUDIO / READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE) to access all music files on your phone
Audio engine fix: restored audio routing in vocal isolation and auto-purify modes — all tracks now play loudly and clearly
Phone music scanner: automatically scan MediaStore and storage folders to import all music on the device
Background playback: uninterrupted music playback when the screen is locked or the app is minimized
Auto purify: every song is analyzed the moment you import it and its music is removed automatically on playback
Offline & private: 100% on-device processing; songs never leave your phone
